description: Unit test class for HonoBasicAuthHandler, verifying authentication handling, error propagation, and malformed header processing.

classes.name: HonoBasicAuthHandlerTest
classes.description: Test suite for HonoBasicAuthHandler, focusing on authentication failure handling and malformed header parsing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mock authentication provider and the handler with an overridden parseCredentials method.

methods.name: testHandleFailsWithStatusCodeFromAuthProvider
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly fails the context with a 503 status when auth provider fails with ServerErrorException.

methods.name: testHandleFailsForMalformedAuthorizationHeader
methods.description: Tests that a malformed Authorization header triggers a ClientErrorException with a 400 status code.
